displayPattern: Outdoor control display flashes d2 (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: System mismatch: the outdoor and indoor units are not an acceptable combination, or the airflow trim settings are set to a prohibited value.
causes: Outdoor and indoor units not a certified combination
Required airflow (CFM) exceeds the indoor unit's maximum
Connected indoor unit is not an EEV type
diySteps: Technician: check that the outdoor and indoor units are a certified combination on the AHRI website; if not, replace to a certified combination
Technician: make sure the airflow trim settings have not been set to a prohibited value
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician or the installer: d2 points to the equipment pairing or airflow settings.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
